title: A Colony for the Gravity
author: Emrys Voss
blurb: Silas Dravenmoor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
